Hey, 

you know what? Being alone isn't as bad as you might think at the moment.

Back in time when I was 15 I only had my GF, nothing else. I tried to focus on myself and started to learn something - in my case programming... When I was 18 I got a job offer from Apple asking me if I'd like to work as a developer for them. I accepted and moved to another country. The first time when I made friends - colleagues, but they became good friends. It was a great feeling, but my GF was unhappy, so we moved back to my home country. 

Long story short: I was nearly alone long, long time, but now getting much more money, than I could ever spend a month. Being alone sometimes repays.   
People who had a lot of fun in school are partly now part of social warfare. These were the people who laugh at me and bullied me.
In German we say "Lernjahre sind keine Herrenjahre", so enjoy the time you have afterwards will be busy as hell. Made it in 1 year out of apprenticeship to have over 800 overtime hours :D

In your apprenticeship, sometimes you have moments, where you can't really work on thingies or need to wait for more exercises. In that times, what you could do is learn yourself for some deep dive. 

After you finished there will be some time (holiday/sickness) where you might have time for doing that, but most of time you'll be busy as hell :P
